title: SigPrivateMind local mind
description: The Signature Private Mind is a Signature original: an offline document Q&A system where the language model, embeddings, and vector store all run on the local machine from one SigMind declaration. Its pipeline, config schema, and privacy guarantees are original Signature designs.

demo.program:
print('SigMind: one declaration, fully local Q&A')
print('edition: Signature original')
demo.expected_output:
SigMind: one declaration, fully local Q&A
edition: Signature original
